top_signals.title: Hong Kong Listing Spree Brings $1.8 Billion to Market in One Day
top_signals.summary: Four companies are lining up to raise as much as a combined HK$14.4 billion ($1.8 billion) in Hong Kong listings, all set to begin trading on Sept. 29.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
